PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

A Fellow member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, Pavan Toshniwal is a founding partner of the firm. His areas of practice include international tax, income tax, transfer pricing, indirect tax and assurance. He is also involved in project financing and private equity funding services.
